_comment: Real published free-tier limits. Edit this file if your account differs - it is read at runtime, no code change needed. rps = requests per second. A value below 1.0 means the provider forces a WAIT between calls (e.g. 0.07 rps = one request every ~14 seconds).

groq.notes: Free tier: 30 RPM org-wide, but the token-per-day cap (TPM/TPD, e.g. llama-3.3-70b ~100K TPD) binds first with 512-token benchmark responses. 0.28 rps (~1 call / 3.5s) keeps us under the token throughput ceiling that was triggering 429s.

nvidia.notes: Free tier: ~40 RPM per model, account level. Credit budget is ambiguous (some accounts 1000 credits ~ 1 credit per call). Budget kept below 1000 to be safe.

gemini.notes: Free tier: Flash/Flash-Lite ~15-30 RPM and 1500 RPD. PRO models were removed from the free tier in Apr-May 2026 - expect them to fail preflight.

mistral.notes: Values taken from the Mistral console 'Completion rate limits per model' page. Several models are FAR below 1 rps - magistral-small at 0.03 rps is one request every 33 seconds.
